title: How to do a TIKTOK Color Picking Trick in PROCREATE #Shorts
description:
Procreate Short Tutorial!
You must've seen these silly color picking videos on TikTok, here's how to do it! 

Want more short tutorials? Leave a comment!

In this short Procreate tutorial we'll do the following:
✔ Create a layer full of noise
✔ Add a glitch effect to add color to the noise
✔ Use the liquify tool set to expand and hold you pencil on the screen
Now you'll never wonder how to do this color picking trick in Procreate again!
